brief:
More than 200 families have been displaced from their homes in the al-Jaldah area of Hebron, according to Maan Wire. Hebron governorate and municipality authorities have opened a children's welfare center as an emergency shelter for the night to accommodate those forced to leave.

The displacement affected residents across the neighborhood, prompting local officials to convert the existing facility into temporary housing to address the immediate crisis.

title: Over 200 families flee homes in Hebron's al-Jaldah neighborhood
